On November i, 2018, Entergy Arkansas, Inc. (EAI) (formerly Arkansas Power
and Light Company) submitted in this Docket an ANO Decommissioning Cost Rider
NDCR Update (Update) including revised Attachment A to the Arkansas Nuclear One
(ANO) Decommissioning Cost Rider (Rider NDCR) and the Direct Testimony and
Exhibits of Lydia W. Joseph.
EAI witness Joseph states that ANO Unit 1's 2019 projected decommissioning
revenue requirement remains zero because its projected decommissioning trust fund
balance is projected to fund the unit's escalated decommissioning cost estimate.
Ms.
Joseph notes that ANO Unit 2's 2019 decommissioning revenue requirement is positive
because the projected trust fund balance for ANO Unit 2 does not exceed the current
escalated decommissioning cost estimate. She remarks that based on 2018 inputs, once
the decommissioning process is complete, the accumulated excess trust fund balance for
Unit l is estimated to be $190.7 million. Ms. Joseph notes that the trust fund balance
for Unit 2 is insufficient to cover its projected decommissioning costs by $135.3 million.
Id. at 5-6.
Ms. Joseph testifies that the estimated bill impact of this update on the
average residential customer with usage of 1,000 kWh per month is an increase of
$0.04, or 0.04 percent. Id. at 7-8.
On December 3, 20l8, the General Staff (Staff) of the Arkansas Public Service
Commission (Commission) submitted the Direct Testimony of Dan Daves.
Mr. Daves

testifies that, given the adequacy of the decommissioning funding for ANO Unit i, the
continued suspension of the Rider NDCR for 2019 is warranted for Unit l. He states
that given the projected inadequacy of the decommissioning fund for ANO Unit 2,
continuation of the Rider NDCR for 2019 is warranted for Unit 2.
Mr. Daves
recommends
that
the
Commission
approve
a
decommissioning
retail
revenue
requirement of $2.051 million and a total decommissioning revenue requirement of
$2.169 million with collections to begin for the new Rider NDCR rates beginning in
January 2019. He recommends that the Commission approve the tariff rates reflected in
Attachment A to Rate Schedule No. 37 (EAI Direct Exhibit LWJ-3, Attachment i, page i
of3, ofEAI's November i, 2018 filing). Id. at 10-11.
On the basis of EAI's tariff filing and the testimony of Ms. Joseph, and of Mr.
Daves' review and recommendations, the Commission finds that EAI's update of Rider
NDCR as filed on November i, 2018, is consistent with the public interest. Accordingly,
the Commission approves the following:
(i)
continued suspension for 2019 of the Unit i component of the rate
for Rider NDCR Unit l;
(2)
a decommissioning retail revenue requirement for ANO Unit 2 of
$2.051 million and a total decommissioning revenue requirement of
$2.169 million; and
(3)
the tariff rates reflected in Attachment A to Rate Schedule No. 37
(EAI Direct Exhibit LWJ-3, Attachment i, page i of 3, of EAI's
November i, 2018 filing), with collections to begin for Rider NDCR
in January 2019.
